summary: Implemented bounded local Estate discovery and rediscovery engine with versioned evidence schema.
Added configurable approved roots and CLI commands for scan, dry-run, diff, apply, status, and inspect.
Integrated apply with existing AI service catalog, model control, knowledge index, and Office service status board projections.
Added focused tests for moves, duplicates, stale/missing entries, ignored/protected paths, malformed artifacts, changed artifacts, inspect, and idempotent rediscovery.
validation: python -m pytest tests/test_estate_discovery_engine.py tests/test_estate_knowledge_index.py tests/test_ai_services_control_plane.py tests/test_model_control.py tests/test_service_status_board.py
